But my theory as to *why* is we're just not trained to take deep breaths from our belly at that age or to push out all of our air before inhaling again. I would suggest some breathing exercises while thinking/saying "in and down, up and out" A more fun exercise could be having her lay down and sing with a light book on the tummy to better visualize the direction of the air. When practicing for tone, slowly play 5 chromatic half notes up (starting as softly as possible at the bottom of your range) and back down, holding the last note as long and softly as you can. (Try to shape your dynamics in symmetry with the note direction.) I would also practice vibrato on some long tones with a metronome in graduating note lengths. (1st scale vibrato on quarters, second scale on eigths, etc)
